title: Homesickness
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What do people usually miss most when they feel homesick: people, food, language, routine, or a sense of belonging?
Does homesickness become easier when you build a new social circle, or can it remain for years?
Can visiting home too often make it harder to adapt to a new country?
What advice would you give someone spending their first year far from home?
Is homesickness always negative, or can it show that a place and its people matter deeply to you?
